objective: Butonsuz, otomatik ilerleyen ve kaydırılabilir rehber; bölüm 1 ilk girişinde otomatik açılma

requirements.remove_buttons: Zero tutorial Button components/DOM buttons; no home/game question-mark controls
requirements.automatic_playback: 5.4 / 7.8 / 5.5 second scenes, last scene closes and resumes live game
requirements.swipe: Left/right touch and mouse, first boundary, final exit, tap/vertical rejection, resize preservation
requirements.first_entry: Production level entry opens first scene once; seen flag persisted; restart/reload does not reopen
requirements.game_state: Board, queue, moves, swap and coins unchanged; only tutorial seen flag written
requirements.presentation: 320/390/landscape screenshots inspected; reduced motion stable and automatic
